en: A vintage black and white image showing a tree-lined street with several people walking and children standing in the middle of the road. The street is flanked by large, classic European-style buildings with ornate details and iron fences. The branches of the trees are bare, suggesting late autumn or winter. The text on the postcard includes the name 'Nijmegen' on the left and 'Bottendaal' on the right, with additional publisher details at the bottom.
